thread:
maria (infra): heads-up — seeing intermittent packet loss between GPU backfill pods across nodes in rack-r12-east2. grpc streams resetting mid-run, p50 latency spikes. Only during large backfills, started ~2h after kernel + mlx5 driver push.

ken (sre): do we have a pcap or iperf results? is it node-specific or hardware model?

infra-bot: [alert] net.packet_loss_high detected on cluster gpu-prod-east2. affected-nodes: r12-02,r12-03,r12-05. severity=medium.

jess (eng-runtime): we flipped RDMA off on a subset yesterday as a mitigation for another issue — possible interaction with geneve/GSO. worth checking offload state and MTU.

sam (netops): can you paste `ethtool -k` and a short tcpdump? also `ip link` and `ip route` for the nodes involved. tcpdump suggestion: `sudo tcpdump -i eth0 -s 256 'tcp' -c 200` or the ack filter: `tcpdump -i eth0 -s 0 -w - 'tcp[tcpflags] & (tcp-syn|tcp-fin|tcp-ack) != 0'`

maria (infra): pasted quick outputs from r12-03 (canary) below:

```
# tcpdump (excerpt)
12:34:01.123456 IP pod-a.43212 > pod-b.443: Flags [P.], seq 123:267, ack 45, win 512, length 144
12:34:01.123789 IP pod-b.443 > pod-a.43212: Flags [.], ack 267, win 256, length 0
12:34:01.124100 IP pod-a.43212 > pod-b.443: Flags [.], ack 45, win 512, length 64
12:34:03.200500 IP pod-a.43212 > pod-b.443: Flags [.], seq 267:411, ack 45, win 512, length 144
# ethtool -k eth0 (r12-03)
features for eth0:
rx-checksumming: on
tx-checksumming: on
gso: on
tso: on
gro: on
lro: off
```

iperf3 run between nodes: 1.6% retransmits at peak during backfill job, baseline <0.1% when idle. note: loss concentrated on small frames (<200B). larger transfers unaffected.

jess (eng-runtime): interesting — pattern points at segmentation/offload interaction (GSO/GRO) with geneve header handling. also could be PMTU discovery failing for encapsulated small packets. quick probe: try disabling GSO/GRO/TCP offloads on one node: `sudo ethtool -K eth0 gro off gso off tso off` and re-run the backfill for 10m.

maria (infra): applied `ethtool -K` on r12-03 (canary). immediate improvement: retransmits ~0.3% and grpc resets dropped to zero for the same load. rolling the change to r12-02 then r12-05. collecting sFlow + kprobe traces for root cause.

ken (sre): good signal. rollout plan: 1) finish r12 rollout (3 nodes) and monitor 60m; 2) if stable, schedule rack-by-rack during low-traffic windows. please file an incident ticket with PCAPs, ethtool outputs, and canary metrics. add Console histograms for grpc latency and retransmits.

sam (netops): follow-up items: verify mlx5 firmware + driver compatibility with geneve offload modes; check for known kernel regressions in the rolled kernel; validate RDMA toggles didn't regress underlay routing. if needed we can re-enable offloads selectively once firmware/kernel fixes are in place.

maria (infra): creating INC-2026-2389, attaching tcpdumps, ethtool dumps, iperf logs, and canary Grafana snapshots. tagging @oncall and @platform-team. will update after 60m. :white_check_mark:

jess (eng-runtime): once stable we should add a diagnostic probe that runs small-packet grpc checks between pods across racks hourly and alerts on >0.5% retransmit. keeps this from regressing when we roll kernels.

maria (infra): thanks — will add the probe to the canary checklist and include an automated ethtool/offload snapshot in our node healthcheck cron.
